name: Elesh Norn
description: Elesh Norn is the Phyrexian Grand Praetor and Mother of Machines, who rules the Machine Orthodoxy from the Fair Basilica on New Phyrexia and wants all life to become Phyrexian under her.

summary.text: Elesh Norn is the Phyrexian Grand Praetor and Mother of Machines, who rules the Machine Orthodoxy from the Fair Basilica on New Phyrexia and wants all life to become Phyrexian under her.

bio.text: She was one of the praetors who compleated the captured Mirran angel Atraxa, and she is said to have shaped Atraxa's body with her own hands.
Tezzeret serves her for a promised reward while hating her, Urabrask refuses to serve her and plans to challenge her control, and Jin-Gitaxias has pledged himself to her.
When Ashiok cast a nightmare over her, she was left shaken and resolved to find Elspeth Tirel and rid the Multiverse of her.
Karn, whom she calls Father as her creator, was brought to New Phyrexia, where she held him captive and took his torso.
She cultivated and corrupted the World Tree Realmbreaker, and when the survivors of the assault on New Phyrexia refused to yield, she began the invasion.
During the invasion she sent her evangels across the Multiverse and had Ajani execute Sheoldred, whom she condemned as a pretender to praeterdom.
At the Invasion Tree she celebrated over the Mirrans and fought Elspeth, who stabbed her shoulder and escaped.
When Zhalfir took New Phyrexia's place, her army turned on her, and Karn killed her himself.

status.text: She is dead, torn apart by her own army and killed by Karn, though a later illusion of her still appears and haunts Ajani.

timeline.summary: Atraxa, a captured Mirran angel, is compleated by Elesh Norn and the other praetors except Urabrask.
timeline.quote: The praetor Elesh Norn honored the angel's tenacity with the blessed gift of Phyrexian compleation

timeline.summary: Jin-Gitaxias announces the first Phyrexianized planeswalker and Tezzeret asks whether Elesh Norn knows.
timeline.quote: Does Elesh Norn know you've succeeded in creating the first Phyrexianized planeswalker?"

timeline.summary: Tezzeret tells Vivien he works for Elesh Norn, and Vivien draws her bow on him in hostility.
timeline.quote: The bowstring was at her cheek in a breath, her opposite arm outstretched.

timeline.summary: Urabrask explains he serves no one and will not give Elesh Norn the Quiet Furnace, and says he will lead a challenge to her control.
timeline.quote: "Yes. I will lead a necessary challenge to Norn's control."

timeline.summary: Urabrask asks Vivien to find Elspeth, a planeswalker whom Norn fears.
timeline.quote: "Norn fears her. That is all I know."

timeline.summary: Norn addresses the Phyrexian faithful in the Fair Basilica's courtyard while holding a captive Mirran, to be flayed and altered as an example of the Machine Orthodoxy.
timeline.quote: "Soon, this wretched human will be released from the burden of fear.

timeline.summary: Norn pours her glistening oil over the Mirran, who convulses and sprouts fibrous roots through her body.
timeline.quote: a pulpy cord of organic material, a fibrous wooden root, sinuous and alien, burst from the human's belly.

timeline.summary: Norn slays the Mirran with a blade of her porcelain armor and tells the crowd she was too corrupt to save, hiding her own unease.
timeline.quote: "She was a vessel so corrupt, not even our glistening oil could save her.

timeline.summary: Norn returns to the courtyard and finds an organic weed sprouting through the flagstones, which turns out to be a human forearm.
timeline.quote: Instead, a human forearm dangled, disproportionately large, half-rotten

timeline.summary: More body-part weeds grow all over the courtyard, and Norn begins to doubt that she herself might be the flaw.
timeline.quote: Was she somehow intrinsically corrupt?

timeline.summary: Norn realizes the world is a dream-like illusion and names the planeswalker Ashiok.
timeline.quote: Scowling, she whispered, "Ashiok."

timeline.summary: Ashiok appears, admits to creating the nightmare as art and testing whether a Phyrexian mind can be afraid.
timeline.quote: I was not certain Phyrexians would be suitable for my art.

timeline.summary: Ashiok reveals a head of Elspeth Tirel in the garden, saying they first encountered her on Theros and sought her in the Underworld.
timeline.quote: "Her name is Elspeth Tirel."

timeline.summary: Norn rejects Ashiok, summoning dream Phyrexians from her own will and declaring that they are one.
timeline.quote: "We are one," Norn said.

timeline.summary: The nightmare garden merges into creatures that attack, and Phyrexians and Norn cut them down.
timeline.quote: The Phyrexians surged forward, slicing through the dream manifestations

timeline.summary: Ashiok shapes a nightmare Elspeth in the mirror of Norn's form, which frightens Norn before she slays it.
timeline.quote: she flung it into the nightmare version of Elspeth Tirel

timeline.summary: Ashiok flees, the nightmare dissolves and Norn is left shaken by the pity in the false Elspeth's eyes.
timeline.quote: She looked at Norn with such human pity

timeline.summary: Norn resolves to find Elspeth Tirel and rid the Multiverse of her.
timeline.quote: she would need to find the human, Elspeth Tirel, and rid the Multiverse of her.

timeline.summary: Karn arrives in a Phyrexian cavern and is welcomed by Elesh Norn, who calls him Father.
timeline.quote: Welcome, Father.

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn shows the helpless Karn a small oil-beaded sapling and calls it the beginning of everything.
timeline.quote: It is the beginning of great things, Father.

timeline.summary: Vivien reveals that Urabrask opposes Elesh Norn, who has nearly unified New Phyrexia and plans to expand her dominion at once.
timeline.quote: That Elesh Norn, a rival praetor, has nearly unified New Phyrexia under her banner,

timeline.summary: An angel blocks Tezzeret from leaving and orders him to carry the pieces of Karn to Elesh Norn for his reward.
timeline.quote: you will bring the pieces of Father to our Mother.

timeline.summary: In the Darksteel Eye, Tezzeret sees vast Phyrexian legions assembling but cannot view Urabrask's domain or Elesh Norn's sanctum.
timeline.quote: he discovered that two locations managed to defy the eye's intrusion.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret reaches Elesh Norn at the heart of the plane, where she takes Karn's torso and welcomes him to the great work.
timeline.quote: We welcome you to our great work.

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn tells Tezzeret he will be herald on Dominaria; he realizes she will not give him his body and resolves to wage war on her.
timeline.quote: Elesh Norn had no intention of fulfilling her promise.

timeline.summary: Karn speaks of Jhoira and is cut off by Elesh Norn; Tezzeret sees it as a good move on his part.
timeline.quote: Jhoira . . . Jhoira is my friend . . . my best friend.

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn dismisses Tezzeret, who leaves angrily.
timeline.quote: With a growl, Tezzeret turned and walked away.

timeline.summary: Koth explains Elesh Norn ossifies her favorites and adds them to her Fair Basilica as the group passes a colossus.
timeline.quote: Turned to bone and added to her Fair Basilica.

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn enters with Phyrexian warriors, Tamiyo, and Jace's risen corpse, welcoming the survivors to Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: Welcome, weary travelers, to Phyrexia,

timeline.summary: Compleated Nahiri and Nissa are revealed beside Elesh Norn.
timeline.quote: Nahiri had clearly not survived her fall.

timeline.summary: The survivors refuse to yield, and Elesh Norn begins the invasion.
timeline.quote: and the invasion began.

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn summons Tezzeret and orders Rona's remains sent to Jin-Gitaxias.
timeline.quote: Send the other to Jin-Gitaxias for reconditioning.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret blames his failure on Rona and Sheoldred's treachery, and Norn accepts it.
timeline.quote: We were routed when our own troops turned on us.

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn questions Tezzeret's love for her, while Tezzeret restrains his urge to kill her.
timeline.quote: One well-placed thrust of his sharpened arm could impale her head or take it right off.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret tells Norn that the Planeswalkers' new leader is Elspeth Tirel, wielding a blade of white light, and Norn grows fearful.
timeline.quote: The leader's name is Elspeth Tirel.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret asks for his promised darksteel body and collapses, and Norn declares a promise is a promise.
timeline.quote: A promise is a promise.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret travels to the ruins of his tower and resolves to wait for the winner of the war to weaken before making his move.
timeline.quote: Then—and only then—would he make his move.

timeline.summary: Norn confronts three captive planeswalkers, Kaya, Kaito and Tyvar, who defy her offer.
timeline.quote: Behold the glory of New Phyrexia.

timeline.summary: Norn summons portals to five planes where Realmbreaker's limbs anchor and release pods of Phyrexian forces.
timeline.quote: Realmbreaker's massive, barb-tipped limbs burst forth, anchoring themselves wherever they please.

timeline.summary: Lukka, Ajani, Atraxa and Nahiri bring in the bound Sheoldred as an offering.
timeline.quote: Carried like a trussed up offering between them is the once powerful Sheoldred.

timeline.summary: Norn has Nahiri encase the three planeswalkers in stone and tells them to be her prophets.
timeline.quote: You shall be the prophets of our coming,

timeline.summary: Norn orders Ajani to execute Sheoldred for craving power over unity, and he beheads her.
timeline.quote: Sheoldred's head bounces to a stop at her feet

timeline.summary: Norn lets the captive planeswalkers escape deliberately so they can spread her gospel.
timeline.quote: Elesh Norn counts on them escaping.

timeline.summary: Norn announces the evangels will unite their homelands and asks Nahiri where she was born.
timeline.quote: we have decided to grant you the honor of uniting your homelands.

timeline.summary: Norn has Nissa show Zendikar's forests and a Skyclave, and Nahiri vows to wake the weapon.
timeline.quote: I can wake it once more to enact our will.

timeline.summary: Norn sends Lukka to Ikoria to add its monsters to Phyrexian ranks, warning him of the price of failure.
timeline.quote: Go to Ikoria. Add these monsters to our ranks.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo and Atraxa discuss Lukka's likely fate and Norn's strategy.
timeline.quote: Either way Phyrexia is served.

timeline.summary: Norn shows Tamiyo the night-lit city of Kamigawa and asks whether she still loves it and her family.
timeline.quote: Do you still care for your family?

timeline.summary: Realmbreaker pierces Kamigawa's city as Tamiyo watches a mother save her children, and a man in black deflects falling tiles.
timeline.quote: Realmbreaker pierces the earth.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo falters when told to welcome the old into the new, and Atraxa reprimands her.
timeline.quote: Insolence isn't tolerated here. You were given a command.

timeline.summary: Norn commands Tamiyo to return with Kamigawa under her control or be recycled.
timeline.quote: Return with Kamigawa under your control or be recycled into something that serves better.

timeline.summary: Ajani correctly guesses Theros is his destination, a first-wave target.
timeline.quote: You want to see Theros.

timeline.summary: Norn orders Ajani to bring a guardian god of Theros within Phyrexia's embrace and to bring priests and the Argent Etchings.
timeline.quote: Bring priests with you,

timeline.summary: Ajani departs for Theros while Norn hides her real reason for sending him.
timeline.quote: he did not discover the real reason she'd sent him to Theros.

timeline.summary: Norn tells Atraxa about the Phyrexian ship sealed away by angels on New Capenna and shows her the city.
timeline.quote: Angels. False prophets bound to stone for their insolence,

timeline.summary: Norn orders Atraxa to harvest New Capenna and destroy the wellspring of Halo.
timeline.quote: You will harvest them all.

timeline.summary: Norn reveals a danger to New Phyrexia exists on New Capenna and Theros, which Atraxa and Ajani must seal.
timeline.quote: In killing New Capenna, we strike at her heart.

timeline.summary: Left alone, Norn calls attendants to recite her teachings to drive away her nightmares of the woman in white.
timeline.quote: Elesh Norn forgets her nightmares

timeline.summary: Nissa reveals the Mother of Machines sent her to stop Chandra, whose plan has already failed.
timeline.quote: The Mother of Machines sent me to stop you.

timeline.summary: Chandra realizes Norn knew about the resistance all along and that it was a trap.
timeline.quote: The whole time they'd been here, she knew what was going on.

timeline.summary: Elspeth falls through other planes and lands at the Invasion Tree on Mirrodin, which Jin-Gitaxias's army fills.
timeline.quote: The Invasion Tree stands as proud testament to the unending triumphs of Elesh Norn.

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn has Urabrask dismembered and Karn brought before her to witness her celebration over shackled Mirrans.
timeline.quote: With another snap she dismisses Urabrask—the centurions chop him into quarters and carry him off.

timeline.summary: Norn tells the Mirrans that they will be freed of their skin's treachery; Elspeth reaches for her sword.
timeline.quote: Elspeth reaches for her sword.

timeline.summary: The voice tells Elspeth that killing Norn will not end the threat, and recounts the tale of the woman in white who made a world of angels.
timeline.quote: Killing her will not end this.

timeline.summary: Koth, Wrenn and Chandra are brought as prisoners, and Elspeth recognizes Nissa as a Phyrexian centurion delivering them.
timeline.quote: "Behold the traitors," speaks one of the centurions

timeline.summary: Norn orders Jin-Gitaxias to harvest what is left of Koth's rebellion and he steps toward the prisoners.
timeline.quote: Jin-Gitaxias. Come harvest what is left of Koth's little rebellion.

timeline.summary: Karn, lashed to slag held aloft by Norn's choir, is being taken apart as Norn taunts him.
timeline.quote: The Phyrexians have been taking him apart, piece by piece, and repurposing his silver body.

timeline.summary: Norn calls Karn the False Patriarch and demands he answer Phyrexia; Jin-Gitaxias raises his claws to strike Karn.
timeline.quote: Jin-Gitaxias raises an arm to strike.

timeline.summary: Elspeth heals Chandra and Koth while Norn rages, throwing pieces of her throne that shatter against Elspeth's wing.
timeline.quote: Healing light flows from her into the pyromancer.

timeline.summary: Norn grabs Jin-Gitaxias by the throat when he suggests retreating, then orders him and Nissa to deal with the prisoners.
timeline.quote: "Dissent is a blasphemy, praetor .

timeline.summary: Norn pulls Elspeth from the air and builds new armor from fallen Phyrexians, while Elspeth burns it with a beam from Godsend.
timeline.quote: A little focus is all it takes to send a searing beam of light at Norn.

timeline.summary: Norn raises walls to block Elspeth and tries to persuade her that her wings make her a Phyrexian.
timeline.quote: What does this form offer you that Phyrexia cannot?

timeline.summary: Elspeth is tempted by Norn's vision of unity with friends such as Ajani and Daxos, but denies they are alike.
timeline.quote: And though she is loath to admit it, there is truth to what Norn is saying.

timeline.summary: Norn tears off Jin-Gitaxias's arm for suggesting she compleat Elspeth, and Elspeth stabs Norn's shoulder, making her bleed and escaping her grip.
timeline.quote: She drives her sword into Norn's wounded shoulder

timeline.summary: Elspeth argues that Norn wants worship for herself, not Phyrexia, enraging Norn who hurls blades.
timeline.quote: Power's the only thing you care about.

timeline.summary: Elspeth dodges Norn's blade storm with a sharp turn and unleashes a ray of light, then flies toward the tree to ensure Wrenn and Chandra make it.
timeline.quote: With all her problems concentrated in one place, Elspeth at last unleashes a ray of light.

timeline.summary: Wrenn grows a massive portal as Elspeth is flung through the gate by a war engine, and the Phyrexian army pours through into Zhalfir's peaceful land.
timeline.quote: The monstrosity flings the angel through the gate

timeline.summary: Vraska rides a Realmbreaker branch down over Ravnica as general for Elesh Norn and has it plunge through the Azorius Senate.
timeline.quote: I choose the simplest one and order a branch to dive straight through its center.

timeline.summary: The sanctum cracks apart as Zhalfir takes New Phyrexia's place, and Norn rails that Phyrexia will never die while her army turns on her.
timeline.quote: "Why aren't any of you protecting me!? I am Phyrexia!"

timeline.summary: Jin-Gitaxias's legions attack Norn, and Ajani defends her, until Zhalfirin warriors capture him alive on Teferi's order.
timeline.quote: "Wait! Take that one alive!"

timeline.summary: Karn builds a new body and Norn crawls skinless toward the portal as her army tears her apart.
timeline.quote: Crawling toward them is a skinless abomination.

timeline.summary: Karn kills Elesh Norn himself and walks through the portal as Teferi resumes time.
timeline.quote: Karn lays a hand on what remains of Norn's head.

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn offers his friends a place among the One, and Tyvar, Kaito and Kaya refuse.
timeline.quote: "Enemies it is," Elesh Norn concludes.

timeline.summary: Jace skims Elesh Norn's mind and learns she has commanded him to go home to Vryn.
timeline.quote: Go home , commands the Mother of Machines, go home.

timeline.summary: Ajani kills a gazelle with his axe and reflects on his guilt over what he did while enslaved to Elesh Norn.
timeline.quote: Ajani struck, and he struck true: his axe cleaved through the gazelle's neck

timeline.summary: The group sees an illusion of Elesh Norn, compleated Nissa and compleated Jace; Chandra and Ajani charge, but Garruk warns it is illusion.
timeline.quote: Ahead, in a massive room at the base of a massive tree, is Elesh Norn, gargantuan and gleaming, straddling the great roots of Realmbreaker.

timeline.summary: The World Tree booms and knocks everyone down; Garruk holds back Ajani as they escape through a portal.
timeline.quote: The Phyrexian World Tree pulses with light, and an immense boom from somewhere inside of it knocks them all to the floor.

The Phyrexian praetor and regent, Mother of Machines, who rules the Machine Orthodoxy and is shaken by a nightmare cast by Ashiok.

A rival praetor who has nearly unified New Phyrexia and plans to force her one singularity on the Multiverse.
The Phyrexian praetor who has barred access to New Phyrexia's core and welcomes Karn as Father; she promises Tezzeret a reward but means to use him.
The praetor whose strategy to bind the planes to New Phyrexia drives the plan.
The praetor who rules New Phyrexia and whose throne sits empty during Ixhel's audience.
A Phyrexian leader who is rumored to have set up the defensive barrier that scattered the team.
A Phyrexian leader who rules from the Fair Basilica and whose World Tree she calls Realmbreaker.
The Phyrexian leader of the Fair Basilica, whose altar the team approaches.
The Phyrexian ruler whose stronghold is the team's target.
The Phyrexian ruler of the Fair Basilica who planted and corrupted Realmbreaker.
The Phyrexian ruler who welcomes the survivors to Phyrexia and starts the invasion.
The Phyrexian ruler on her throne in the Fair Basilica who grants Tezzeret his reward and is afraid of Elspeth Tirel.
The Phyrexian Grand Praetor who dispatches her evangels to every corner of the Multiverse and executes Sheoldred.
The Phyrexian leader whose fleshless legions lead the invasion.
The Phyrexian ruler whose skeletal branches strike Kamigawa.
The Phyrexian ruler whose orders are to harvest New Capenna.
The Phyrexian ruler who anticipated the resistance.

The Phyrexian Grand Praetor who rules the Invasion Tree sanctuary and builds armor from fallen soldiers while trying to persuade or crush Elspeth.
The Phyrexian Grand Praetor who fights Elspeth as the portal opens.

The Phyrexian leader whose death rendered the oil inert.

The Phyrexian Mother of Machines, who offers Jace's friends a place among the One and commands him to go home.

The Phyrexian praetor to whom Ajani wanted to offer Elspeth's corpse.
